==English==

===Etymology===
{{dercat|en|qsb-grc}}
From {{der|en|frm|chilindre}}, {{m|frm|cylindre}}, from {{der|en|la|cylindrus}}, from {{der|en|grc|κύλινδρος}}, from {{m|grc|κυλίνδω}} "I roll or wallow" (intransitive). {{doublet|en|calander|calender}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈsɪlɪndə(ɹ)/|a=UK}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈsɪləndɚ/|[ˈsɪlɪ̈ndɚ]|a=US}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-cylinder.ogg|a=US}}

===Noun===
[[File:Cylinder geometry.svg|thumb|right|A drawing of a cylinder showing the height at the center.]]
[[File:Colt Python IMG 6785.jpg|thumb|The cylinder ({{senseno|en|Q1364476}}) of a [[revolver#English:_Q170382|revolver]].]]
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|geometry}} A surface created by projecting a closed two-dimensional curve along an axis intersecting the plane of the curve. {{C|en|Surfaces}}
#: {{ux|en|When the two-dimensional curve is a circle, the cylinder is called a circular '''cylinder'''. When the axis is perpendicular to the plane of the curve, the '''cylinder''' is called a right '''cylinder'''. In non-mathematical usage, both right and circular are usually implied.}}
# {{lb|en|geometry}} A solid figure bounded by a cylinder and two parallel planes intersecting the cylinder.
# Any object in the form of a circular cylinder.
# A [[cylindrical]] cavity or chamber in a mechanism, such as the counterpart to a piston found in a piston-driven engine.
# {{senseid|en|Q245656}}{{lb|en|automotive}} The space in which a [[piston]] travels inside a [[reciprocating engine]] or [[pump]].
# {{senseid|en|container for gas}} A container in the form of a cylinder with rounded ends for storing pressurized gas; a {{l|en|gas cylinder}}.
# An early form of phonograph recording, made on a [[wax cylinder]].
# {{senseid|en|Q1364476}} The part of a [[revolver#English:_Q170382|revolver]] that contains [[chamber]]s for the [[cartridge]]s.
# {{lb|en|computing}} The corresponding [[track]]s on a [[vertical]] arrangement of [[disk]]s in a [[disk drive]] considered as a unit of [[data]] [[capacity]].
